title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄序
聖天子御極誕敷
皇猷懋懋昭文化開科取士至是蓋
凡九舉焉法愈精嚴視往昔
稱得人尤盛猗歟休哉誠
昭代之盛典也今歲丙午秋復當
其期河南遵
===
制舉其事監察御史侯〔度〕奉
命巡按茲土實監臨之體忠効信
申飭規程惟嚴惟公且克翼
焉先期幣函徧諮延聘師儒
以司校文之役及期畢至則
以〔入〕〔縄〕暨教諭鄭〔川〕〔賓〕爲考
以〔入〕〔縄〕暨教諭鄭〔川〕〔賓〕爲考
試官學正林〔金〕教諭蔡〔節〕偕
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄序

聖天子御極，誕敷皇猷，懋懋昭文化，開科取士，至是蓋凡九舉焉。法愈精嚴，視往昔，稱得人尤盛。猗歟休哉！誠昭代之盛典也。今歲丙午秋，復當其期，河南遵制舉其事。監察御史侯〔度〕奉命巡按茲土，實監臨之，體忠効信，申飭規程，惟嚴惟公，且克翼焉。先期幣函徧諮，延聘師儒，以司校文之役。及期畢至，則以〔入〕〔縄〕暨教諭鄭〔川〕〔賓〕爲考，以〔入〕〔縄〕暨教諭鄭〔川〕〔賓〕爲考試官，學正林〔金〕、教諭蔡〔節〕偕
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

Since the sagely Son of Heaven ascended the throne, he has broadly disseminated his imperial plans, diligently promoted cultural instruction [?], and instituted examinations to select scholars. By now these have been held nine times in all. The regulations have become ever more exacting and strict; compared with former times, the examinations are acclaimed as especially successful in obtaining worthy men. Ah, how splendid! This is indeed a magnificent institution of an illustrious age. In the autumn of this bingwu year [1546], the appointed time came around again, and Henan conducted the examination in accordance with imperial regulations.

Investigating Censor Hou Du, commissioned to conduct an inspection tour of this territory, served as Supervising Official. Embodying loyalty and demonstrating trustworthiness, he reiterated and enforced the regulations, maintaining strictness and impartiality and conducting himself with reverent care. Before the appointed date, gifts and letters were sent out widely to seek and engage learned teachers to undertake the evaluation of examination essays. When the date arrived, all had assembled. Thereupon, an official whose name is garbled [?], together with Instructor Zheng Chuanbin [?], was appointed as Exam—[the transcription repeats this phrase] an official whose name is garbled [?], together with Instructor Zheng Chuanbin [?], was appointed as Examiner; School Instructor Lin Jin and Instructor Cai Jie, together with …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
〔縉〕胡〔東陵〕楊〔淮〕鄭〔臣〕李〔應科〕
爲同考試官僉以是役重且
艱胥飭胥毖提調則左參政
金〔清〕右參政丘〔茂中〕監試則
按察使朱〔良〕副使陳〔洙〕及諸
執事悉遴選以充乃於八月
庚寅入院御史侯〔度〕登堂集
===
衆申重盟誓期於澡瀹志慮
秉持衡鑑務得真才以上副
聖天子側席求賢之意以少塞我
臣子職分衆罔不唯唯是承
既鎖院乃合提學副使孫〔應〕
〔奎〕所選士千九百有奇三試
之拔其俊者八十人錄其文
punctuated: 〔縉〕、胡〔東陵〕、楊〔淮〕、鄭〔臣〕、李〔應科〕爲同考試官，僉以是役重且艱，胥飭胥毖。提調則左參政金〔清〕、右參政丘〔茂中〕，監試則按察使朱〔良〕、副使陳〔洙〕，及諸執事，悉遴選以充。乃於八月庚寅入院，御史侯〔度〕登堂集衆，申重盟誓，期於澡瀹志慮，秉持衡鑑，務得真才，以上副聖天子側席求賢之意，以少塞我臣子職分。衆罔不唯唯是承。既鎖院，乃合提學副使孫〔應〕〔奎〕所選士千九百有奇，三試之，拔其俊者八十人，錄其文
translation_en:
…Jin [?], Hu Dongling, Yang Huai, Zheng Chen, and Li Yingke served as Associate Examiners. All considered this assignment weighty and difficult, and all conducted themselves with discipline and caution. The Proctors were Left Administration Vice Commissioner Jin Qing and Right Administration Vice Commissioner Qiu Maozhong; those overseeing the examination were Surveillance Commissioner Zhu Liang and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Chen Zhu. All the other functionaries were likewise carefully selected to fill their posts.

On the gengyin day of the eighth month, they entered the examination compound. Censor Hou Du ascended the hall, assembled everyone, and solemnly reiterated the oath. They were to cleanse their minds and intentions, uphold the standards of judgment, and strive to obtain men of genuine talent, thereby fulfilling the sagely Son of Heaven’s earnest desire to seek worthy men and discharging at least some part of their duty as his servants and subjects. Everyone assented respectfully.

After the compound had been locked, they assembled the more than nineteen hundred candidates selected by Sun Yingkui, the Surveillance Vice Commissioner in charge of education, and examined them in three sessions. They selected eighty outstanding men and transcribed their compositions…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
之精者二十篇以
獻〔入繩〕猥以執事例當有言竊
惟河南當天地之中古義禹
之遺跡而成周之故墟也嵩
行盤礴河洛逶迤風氣萃交
多產賢哲載昔可稽矣〔入繩〕
於是役也固心領其必得人
===
矣肆觀其文則見其言非徒
文理契於心道德性命闡其
奧天時地理述其詳人情物
則究其端爲政致治之義開
陳而無餘法且博達閎衍可
以徵才淵涵停蓄可以識量
灝發流暢可以占氣操切峻
punctuated:
之精者二十篇，以獻。〔入繩〕猥以執事，例當有言。竊惟河南當天地之中，古義禹之遺跡，而成周之故墟也。嵩行盤礴，河洛逶迤，風氣萃交，多產賢哲，載昔可稽矣。〔入繩〕於是役也，固心領其必得人矣。
肆觀其文，則見其言非徒文，理契於心；道德性命，闡其奧；天時地理，述其詳；人情物則，究其端；爲政致治之義，開陳而無餘。法且博達閎衍，可以徵才；淵涵停蓄，可以識量；灝發流暢，可以占氣；操切峻
translation_en:
…the twenty finest essays, for submission to the throne. I, 〔Rusheng〕, unworthily serving in this undertaking, am obliged by customary practice to offer some words. I humbly reflect that Henan lies at the center of Heaven and Earth, preserving the traces of ancient Yi [?] and Yu and the former seat of Chengzhou. Mount Song and the Taihang Mountains [?] rise in massive grandeur; the Yellow and Luo Rivers wind through the land. Winds and vital influences converge here, producing many worthy and wise men, as the records of the past attest. In this undertaking, I, 〔Rusheng〕, was therefore inwardly certain that we would find worthy men.
Upon surveying their essays, I saw that their words were more than mere literary ornament: their principles accorded with the mind. They elucidated the mysteries of the Way, virtue, human nature, and destiny; expounded the particulars of heavenly seasons and earthly configurations; investigated the sources of human feelings and the patterns governing things; and set forth exhaustively the principles of administering government and bringing about good order. Their method, moreover [?], was comprehensive, penetrating, expansive, and ample, furnishing evidence of talent; their depth and accumulated reserves revealed their capacity; their abundant expression and fluent movement disclosed their vital energy; their incisiveness and stern…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
凝可以證節皆本之乎平正
光明之懿矩而宣洩乎趨向
存含之妙義罔非大受遠到
之資而誠可以應
今日賢能之選者也匪徒以其綜
輯辭采錯比文華燦然蔚然
已爾不其偉歟豈其以山河
===
之靈淑鄉先哲之遺澤然乎
昔嘗讀詩而見有周人才之
盛一時䟽附先後奔走禦侮
罔不充備竊以為天厚有周
而產才若是及讀棫樸之章
則又曰周王壽考遐不作人
然後知有周人才之盛固化
punctuated:
凝，可以證節。皆本之乎平正光明之懿矩，而宣洩乎趨向存含之妙義，罔非大受遠到之資，而誠可以應今日賢能之選者也。匪徒以其綜輯辭采，錯比文華，燦然蔚然已爾，不其偉歟？豈其以山河之靈淑、鄉先哲之遺澤然乎？
昔嘗讀詩，而見有周人才之盛，一時䟽附、先後、奔走、禦侮，罔不充備。竊以為天厚有周，而產才若是。及讀《棫樸》之章，則又曰：「周王壽考，遐不作人？」然後知有周人才之盛，固化
translation_en:
…firmness attests to their integrity. All take as their foundation the admirable standards of evenhandedness, uprightness, and clarity, and give expression to the subtle meaning of their aspirations and inward cultivation. All possess the capacity to shoulder great responsibilities and attain far-reaching achievements; they truly qualify for today’s selection of the worthy and capable. Their merit does not lie merely in assembling elegant diction and arranging literary embellishments into a brilliant, luxuriant display. Is this not magnificent? Could it be due to the numinous excellence of the mountains and rivers and the enduring beneficence of this region’s earlier sages?
I once read the Book of Odes and saw how abundant were the talented men of Zhou. Those who brought others into allegiance, those who assisted and guided, those who hastened about in service, and those who resisted aggression were all present in full measure. I privately thought that Heaven had favored Zhou by producing such talent. But when I read the ode “Yu Pu” (The Oak and the Thorn), it also said: “May the king of Zhou live long! Does he not nurture men?” Only then did I understand that Zhou’s abundance of talent was indeed the result of moral transformation…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
使之然也弘惟我
皇上資稟
神聖
極建中和
德澤教化汪濊旁達旣亦有年薄
海內外胥成於變而
位育之効至於格鳥獸被草木
===
無愛道無愛寶者矣矧玆髦
士涵濡漸摩獨深者乎又矧
玆土密邇
畿甸沾被尤先者乎則
今日人文之盛固宜彬彬濟濟高
出成周之上而非以其山河
之靈淑鄉先哲之遺澤已也
punctuated: 使之然也。弘惟我皇上，資稟神聖，極建中和，德澤教化汪濊旁達，旣亦有年。薄海內外，胥成於變，而位育之効，至於格鳥獸、被草木，無愛道、無愛寶者矣。矧玆髦士涵濡漸摩獨深者乎？又矧玆土密邇畿甸，沾被尤先者乎？則今日人文之盛，固宜彬彬濟濟，高出成周之上，而非以其山河之靈淑、鄉先哲之遺澤已也。
translation_en: …has brought this about. We reverently reflect that our Emperor is endowed with sagely wisdom and has established the supreme standard of equilibrium and harmony. His beneficence and transforming instruction have flowed abundantly in every direction for many years. Throughout the realm and beyond, to the very seas, all have undergone transformation. The effects of bringing all things into their proper places and nourishing their growth extend even to birds and beasts, grasses and trees: Heaven withholds none of its Way, and Earth none of its treasures. How much more, then, must this hold for these outstanding scholars, who have been especially deeply steeped in and shaped by this influence? And how much more for this land, so close to the metropolitan domain, which has been among the very first to receive these blessings? Thus the present flourishing of literary culture should indeed produce a multitude of cultivated and accomplished men, far surpassing even the perfected Zhou. It is not due merely to the spiritual excellence of its mountains and rivers or to the enduring beneficence of the region’s former worthies.

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
雖然愚尤有言焉嘗聞之山
谷出雲而雨乎天下河海委
潤而澤乎千里言致用也爾
多士績學種德於鄉所以希
採擢以求表見於世嘗虞其
不獲進今幸進矣將通仕籍
以服有政矣其亦思所以致
===
用也哉仰惟
聖天子在上明良之遇亘古爲難
勵翼効忠正其時也尚思所
以表庸樹勛以廣其致用之
術以求無負賢能之選則名
流芳播他日人固指之爲某
科得人則予主司亦與有榮
punctuated:
雖然，愚尤有言焉。嘗聞之：山谷出雲而雨乎天下，河海委潤而澤乎千里，言致用也。爾多士績學種德於鄉，所以希採擢，以求表見於世，嘗虞其不獲進。今幸進矣，將通仕籍以服有政矣，其亦思所以致用也哉！
仰惟聖天子在上，明良之遇，亘古爲難。勵翼効忠，正其時也。尚思所以表庸樹勛，以廣其致用之術，以求無負賢能之選。則名流芳播，他日人固指之爲某科得人，則予主司亦與有榮
translation_en:
Even so, I still have something to say. I have heard that mountains and valleys send forth clouds to rain upon all under Heaven, and rivers and seas gather moisture to nourish a thousand li: this speaks of putting one's capacities to use. You scholars have accumulated learning and cultivated virtue in your home communities, hoping to be selected and promoted so that you might distinguish yourselves in the world, yet always fearing that you would not advance. Now, fortunately, you have advanced. You will enter the rolls of officialdom and undertake the work of government. Should you not also consider how to put your capacities to use?
Reverently reflecting that the sagely Son of Heaven reigns above, I find that the meeting of an enlightened ruler and worthy ministers has been rare throughout the ages. This is precisely the time to exert yourselves in assisting him and to render loyal service. Endeavor, then, to consider how to demonstrate your merit and establish achievements, broadening the means by which you put your capacities to use and seeking to prove worthy of your selection as men of virtue and ability. Then your names will endure and your good reputations spread. In days to come, people will surely point to this examination session as one that obtained worthy men, and I too, as its presiding examiner, shall share in the honor…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
光矣若曰藉是以爲富貴之
媒而裂維潰防則上有負
聖天子之作養下有愧山河之靈
淑而遠亦含羞於鄉先哲之
遺澤矣非予輩所望於爾多
士者也其尚與勗諸夫是舉
也則有巡撫右副都御史柯
===
相
懋勤保釐篤興文教總理
河道右副都御史詹〔瀚〕撫治
鄖陽右副都御史葉〔照〕胥敕
典常振起士風巡鹽監察御
史王〔忬〕張〔洽〕篤脩憲籥用作
士類刑部郎中王〔崇義〕行人
王〔楠〕趙〔帨〕宿〔應參〕王〔鶴〕徐〔洛〕
punctuated:
光矣。若曰藉是以爲富貴之媒，而裂維潰防，則上有負聖天子之作養，下有愧山河之靈淑，而遠亦含羞於鄉先哲之遺澤矣，非予輩所望於爾多士者也。其尚與勗諸！
夫是舉也，則有巡撫右副都御史柯相，懋勤保釐，篤興文教；總理河道右副都御史詹〔瀚〕、撫治鄖陽右副都御史葉〔照〕，胥敕典常，振起士風；巡鹽監察御史王〔忬〕、張〔洽〕，篤脩憲籥，用作士類；刑部郎中王〔崇義〕、行人王〔楠〕、趙〔帨〕、宿〔應參〕、王〔鶴〕、徐〔洛〕
translation_en:
…share in the glory. If, however, you use this as a means to wealth and rank, tearing apart the bonds of order and breaching its safeguards, then above you will betray the sage Son of Heaven’s nurturing care, and below you will disgrace the numinous excellence of these mountains and rivers. Looking further back, you will also stand ashamed before the beneficent legacy of your region’s former worthies. This is not what we expect of you scholars. May you encourage one another in this!
For this examination, Ke Xiang 柯相, Grand Coordinator and Right Vice Censor-in-chief, diligently maintained peace and good governance and earnestly promoted literary education. Zhan Han 詹瀚, Director-general of River Conservancy and Right Vice Censor-in-chief, and Ye Zhao 葉照, Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang and Right Vice Censor-in-chief, both upheld established institutions and norms and invigorated the ethos of scholars. Wang Yu 王忬 and Zhang Qia 張洽, Investigating Censors for Salt Control, assiduously maintained the instruments of censorial authority [?], thereby inspiring the scholars. Wang Chongyi 王崇義, Director in the Ministry of Justice; and the Messengers Wang Nan 王楠, Zhao Shui 趙帨, Su Yingcan 宿應參, Wang He 王鶴, and Xu Luo 徐洛…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
皆以公事至樂觀厥成焉若
左布政使李〔充濁〕右叅政李
仁左叅議李〔樂〕右叅議常〔時〕
平副使商〔大節〕何〔繼之〕劉〔汀〕
李〔晁〕僉事劉〔佐〕李〔延康〕張〔舜〕
臣許〔天倫〕唐〔錡〕劉〔望之〕都指
揮僉事李〔偘〕王〔執敬〕周〔寶〕皆
===
素裡士教令則防範於外於
法得備書云
江西袁州府分宜縣儒學教
諭曲〔入繩〕謹序
punctuated:
皆以公事至，樂觀厥成焉。若左布政使李〔充濁〕、右叅政李仁、左叅議李〔樂〕、右叅議常〔時〕平、副使商〔大節〕、何〔繼之〕、劉〔汀〕、李〔晁〕、僉事劉〔佐〕、李〔延康〕、張〔舜〕臣、許〔天倫〕、唐〔錡〕、劉〔望之〕、都指揮僉事李〔偘〕、王〔執敬〕、周〔寶〕，皆素裡士教，令則防範於外，於法得備，書云。
江西袁州府分宜縣儒學教諭曲〔入繩〕謹序。
translation_en:
…all came on official business and were pleased to witness its successful completion. As for Li Chongzhuo, Left Administration Commissioner; Li Ren, Right Associate Administration Commissioner; Li Le, Left Assistant Administration Commissioner; Chang Shiping, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner; Shang Dajie, He Jizhi, Liu Ting, and Li Chao, Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Liu Zuo, Li Yankang, Zhang Shunchen, Xu Tianlun, Tang Qi, and Liu Wangzhi, Assistant Surveillance Commissioners; and Li Kan, Wang Zhijing, and Zhou Bao, Assistant Regional Military Commissioners: all had long been involved in the education of scholars [?]. They provided safeguards on the outside [?], ensuring that the prescribed arrangements were complete. This is hereby recorded.
Respectfully composed as a preface by Qu Rusheng, Instructor of the Confucian School of Fenyi County, Yuanzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi.

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試
監臨官
巡按河南監察御史侯度〔應甫山東東阿縣人　壬辰進士〕
提調官
河南等處承宣布政使司左參政金清〔廉夫應天府上元縣籍　直隸滁州人己丑進士〕
河南等處承宣布政使司右參政岳茂中〔子時福建莆田縣人　辛巳進士〕
監試官
河南等處提刑按察司按察使朱良〔遂夫浙江慈谿縣人　甲戌進士〕
河南等處提刑按察司副使陳洙〔道源浙江上虞縣人　己丑進士〕
===
考試官
江西袁州府分宜縣儒學教諭曲繩〔子約湖廣沅陵縣人　甲午貢士〕
浙江衢州府常山縣儒學教諭鄭賔〔子觀福建莆田縣人　丁酉貢士〕
同考試官
湖廣靖州儒學學正林金〔聲之福建連江縣人　丁酉貢士〕

直隸保定府清苑縣儒學教諭崔繐〔淳甫直隸江都縣人　癸卯貢士〕

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
仰之彌高鑽之彌堅瞻之在前忽焉在後
誠之者擇善而固執之者也
得天下英才而敎育之三樂也
易
黃裳元吉文在中也
動靜不失其時其道光明
子曰易其至矣乎夫易聖人所以崇德而
廣業也知崇禮卑崇效天卑法地天地
設位而易行乎其中矣成性存存道義
===
之門
發揮於剛柔而生爻
書
翕受敷施九德咸事俊乂在官百僚師師
百工惟時撫于五辰庶績其凝
嶓冢導漾東流爲漢又東爲滄浪之水過
三澨至于大別南入于江東匯澤爲彭
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書

仰之彌高，鑽之彌堅，瞻之在前，忽焉在後。

誠之者，擇善而固執之者也。

得天下英才而敎育之，三樂也。

易

黃裳元吉，文在中也。

動靜不失其時，其道光明。

子曰：「易其至矣乎！夫易，聖人所以崇德而廣業也。知崇禮卑，崇效天，卑法地。天地設位，而易行乎其中矣。成性存存，道義之門。」

發揮於剛柔而生爻。

書

翕受敷施，九德咸事，俊乂在官，百僚師師，百工惟時，撫于五辰，庶績其凝。

嶓冢導漾，東流爲漢，又東爲滄浪之水，過三澨，至于大別，南入于江，東匯澤爲彭
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The more I look up to it, the higher it rises; the more I bore into it, the harder it becomes. I see it before me, and suddenly it is behind me.

One who makes himself sincere chooses what is good and holds firmly to it.

To obtain the outstanding talents of the realm and educate them is the third joy.

Book of Changes

“A yellow lower garment: supreme good fortune”—refinement resides within.

In movement and stillness, never missing the proper time: thus is the Way radiant and clear.

The Master said: “How consummate the Changes are! Through the Changes, the sage exalts his virtue and broadens his undertakings. Wisdom is lofty; ritual is humble. The lofty emulates Heaven; the humble models itself on Earth. Heaven and Earth take their positions, and change operates between them. To preserve continually one's fully realized nature is the gateway to the Way and righteousness.”

Unfolding through the firm and the yielding, it produces the lines of the hexagrams.

Book of Documents

He comprehensively received and widely bestowed; all nine virtues were put into service. Men of outstanding talent held office, and the officials took one another as models. The various officers attended to their duties in due season, in accord with the five celestial markers of time, and all achievements were brought to completion.

From Bozhong, he traced the Yang River, which flows east and becomes the Han, then farther east becomes the waters of Canglang. It passes Sanshi and reaches Dabie, enters the Yangzi to the south, and eastward gathers into a marsh, forming Peng…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
彙東為北江入于海
皇建其有極斂時五福
公其惟時成周建無窮之基亦有無窮之
聞
詩
蔽芾甘棠勿翦勿伐召伯所茇
天保定爾以莫不興如山如阜如岡如陵
如川之方至以莫不增
維秬維秠維穈維芑
貽我來牟帝命率育無此疆爾界陳常于
===
時夏
春秋
春鄭人來輸平〔隱公六年〕
王人子突救衛〔莊公六年〕春王正月城楚
丘〔僖公二年〕
六月公會單子晉侯宋公衛侯鄭伯莒子
邾子齊世子光己未同盟于雞澤〔襄公
三年〕
punctuated:
彙，東為北江，入于海。
皇建其有極，斂時五福。
公其惟時成周建無窮之基，亦有無窮之聞。

詩
蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。
天保定爾，以莫不興。如山如阜，如岡如陵，如川之方至，以莫不增。
維秬維秠，維穈維芑。
貽我來牟，帝命率育。無此疆爾界，陳常于時夏。

春秋
春，鄭人來輸平。〔隱公六年〕
王人子突救衛。〔莊公六年〕春，王正月，城楚丘。〔僖公二年〕
六月，公會單子、晉侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、莒子、邾子、齊世子光，己未，同盟于雞澤。〔襄公三年〕
translation_en:
…[Lake Peng]li; eastward it becomes the Northern Jiang and enters the sea.
The sovereign establishes the supreme standard and gathers these five blessings.
You, Duke, will thereby lay an everlasting foundation for the completed Zhou realm and enjoy everlasting renown.

Book of Odes
The spreading sweet pear tree: do not trim it or cut it down, for it was where the Earl of Sha rested.
Heaven protects and secures you, so that everything flourishes. Like mountains and hills, like ridges and great heights, like a river swelling with its incoming waters, may everything increase.
There are black millet and double-grained black millet, red millet and white millet.
He bestowed wheat and barley upon us; God commanded that all be nourished. Without boundaries dividing ours from yours, the enduring order was established throughout this land of Xia.

Spring and Autumn Annals
In spring, men of Zheng came to make peace. 〔Sixth year of Duke Yin.〕
Zitu, an officer of the king, came to the relief of Wei. 〔Sixth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 In spring, in the first month of the royal calendar, fortifications were built at Chuqiu. 〔Second year of Duke Xi.〕
In the sixth month, the duke met with the Viscount of Shan, the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, and Guang, heir apparent of Qi. On the jiwei day, they jointly concluded a covenant at Jize. 〔Third year of Duke Xiang.〕

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
春王三月及齊平　夏公會齊侯于夾谷
公至自夾谷　齊人來歸鄆讙龜陰田
〔俱定公十年〕
禮記
故人情者聖王之田也
大學之法禁於未發之謂豫當其可之謂
時不陵節而施之謂孫相觀而善之謂
摩此四者教之所由興也
子曰仁之難成久矣唯君子能之是故君
子不以其所能者病人不以人之所不
===
能者愧人
射者何以射何以聽循聲而發發而不失
正鵠者其唯賢者乎
第貳場
論
君子莫大乎與人爲善
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢定振窮養老之令詔〔文帝元年〕
punctuated:
春，王三月，及齊平。夏，公會齊侯于夾谷。公至自夾谷。齊人來歸鄆、讙、龜陰田。〔俱定公十年〕

禮記
故人情者，聖王之田也。
大學之法，禁於未發之謂豫，當其可之謂時，不陵節而施之謂孫，相觀而善之謂摩。此四者，教之所由興也。
子曰：「仁之難成久矣，唯君子能之。是故君子不以其所能者病人，不以人之所不能者愧人。」
射者何以射？何以聽？循聲而發，發而不失正鵠者，其唯賢者乎？

第貳場
論
君子莫大乎與人爲善。

詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢定振窮養老之令詔〔文帝元年〕
translation_en:
In spring, in the third month of the royal calendar, we made peace with Qi. In summer, the duke met the Marquis of Qi at Jiagu. The duke returned from Jiagu. Men of Qi came to restore the lands of Yun, Huan, and Guiyin. 〔All from the tenth year of Duke Ding.〕

Record of Rites (Liji)
Thus human feelings are the field cultivated by the sage kings.
The methods of the Great Learning are these: preventing misconduct before it arises is called anticipation; acting at the appropriate moment is called timeliness; teaching without overstepping the stages of learning is called orderly progression; learning from one another through mutual observation is called mutual refinement. These four are the means by which teaching flourishes.
The Master said: “It has long been difficult to perfect benevolence; only the gentleman can accomplish it. Therefore, the gentleman does not reproach others on the strength of his own abilities, nor shame them for what they cannot do.”
To what does the archer shoot? To what does he listen? To release the arrow in accordance with the music, and to release it without missing the center of the target—is this not something only the worthy can accomplish?

Second Session
Discourse
For the gentleman, nothing is greater than joining with others in doing good.

Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One question within this category [?].〕
Compose, in the voice of the Han emperor, an edict establishing regulations for relieving the destitute and supporting the aged. 〔First year of Emperor Wen.〕

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
擬唐以孫伏伽爲諫議大夫誥〔貞觀元年〕
擬宋以歐陽脩參知政事謝表〔嘉祐六年〕
判語五條
工樂户及婦人犯罪
守支錢糧及擅開官封
收藏禁書及私習天文
私出外境及違禁下海
毆制使及本管長官
第叁場
===
策五道
問一代之興必有一代之製典謨訓誥垂
布萬世帝王德業具在邈乎上矣降而
漢唐宋英君誼辟代亦有作其間有稱
號令文章煥然可述者有稱爲文賦詩
贍麗沖邁者有稱援翰屬思極其精妙
者擬之帝王之製不識有相類歟其於
治理關係何如也我
太祖高皇帝開基於前
punctuated:
擬唐以孫伏伽爲諫議大夫誥〔貞觀元年〕。
擬宋以歐陽脩參知政事謝表〔嘉祐六年〕。
判語五條：工樂户及婦人犯罪；守支錢糧及擅開官封；收藏禁書及私習天文；私出外境及違禁下海；毆制使及本管長官。
第叁場
策五道
問：一代之興，必有一代之製。典謨訓誥，垂布萬世，帝王德業具在，邈乎上矣。降而漢唐宋，英君誼辟，代亦有作。其間有稱號令文章煥然可述者，有稱爲文賦詩贍麗沖邁者，有稱援翰屬思極其精妙者。擬之帝王之製，不識有相類歟？其於治理關係何如也？我太祖高皇帝開基於前，
translation_en:
Compose an investiture edict in the manner of the Tang appointing Sun Fuga as Grand Master of Remonstrance. 〔First year of Zhenguan〕
Compose a memorial of thanks in the voice of Ouyang Xiu upon his appointment as Participant in Determining Governmental Matters under the Song. 〔Sixth year of Jiayou〕
Five legal judgments:
1. Crimes committed by members of artisan and musician households, and by women.
2. Custody and disbursement of money and grain, and unauthorized opening of official seals.
3. Possession of prohibited books and private study of astronomy.
4. Unauthorized departure beyond the borders and putting to sea in violation of prohibitions.
5. Assaulting an imperial commissioner or one’s directly supervising chief official.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: When a dynasty rises, it must have writings of its own. The canons, counsels, instructions, and announcements have been transmitted to ten thousand generations; the virtue and achievements of emperors and kings are fully embodied in them. Loftily they stand above all! Coming down to the Han, Tang, and Song, illustrious rulers and righteous sovereigns also produced writings in each dynasty. Among them were those praised for proclamations and literary compositions whose brilliance merited recounting; those praised for prose and poetry that were rich and elegant, serene and lofty; and those praised for taking up the brush and composing thoughts of the utmost refinement and subtlety. Compared with the writings of the ancient emperors and kings, might these bear any resemblance? What bearing do they have on governance? Our Emperor Taizu Gao laid the foundations before …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
成祖文皇帝繼統於後皆有
製作以詔天下家傳人誦者久矣敬舉一二與
諸士頌之如
大誥有編
資世通訓有書所以勸戒臣民綱維治理者
憂世之念深矣其詳有可言歟
精誠有錄
存心省躬有錄所以察於敬忽明於災祥者
兢業之心切矣其義有可聞歟
===
孝順事實有書
爲善陰隲有書諄諄焉勵俗勸世宏綱要領
可舉其一二歟
聖學心法有書
性理大全有書惓惓焉立教脩身微詞奥旨
可測其端倪歟經緯天地昭如日星誠
一代之製也迨我
皇上聰明神聖應運
中興發爲
punctuated: 成祖文皇帝繼統於後，皆有製作以詔天下，家傳人誦者久矣。敬舉一二，與諸士頌之。如《大誥》有編，《資世通訓》有書，所以勸戒臣民、綱維治理者，憂世之念深矣。其詳有可言歟？《精誠》有錄，《存心省躬》有錄，所以察於敬忽、明於災祥者，兢業之心切矣。其義有可聞歟？《孝順事實》有書，《爲善陰隲》有書，諄諄焉勵俗勸世，宏綱要領，可舉其一二歟？《聖學心法》有書，《性理大全》有書，惓惓焉立教脩身，微詞奥旨，可測其端倪歟？經緯天地，昭如日星，誠一代之製也。迨我皇上聰明神聖，應運中興，發爲
translation_en:
…and Emperor Wen, Chengzu, continued the imperial succession thereafter. Both produced writings to instruct all under Heaven, long handed down in households and recited by individuals. Let us respectfully cite one or two and praise them together with you scholars. There is the compilation Great Pronouncements (Da gao), and the book Comprehensive Instructions to Aid the World (Zishi tongxun). In encouraging and admonishing subjects and sustaining orderly government, these reveal profound concern for the world. Can you explain their particulars? There is the Record of Utmost Sincerity (Jingcheng), and the Record of Preserving the Mind and Examining Oneself (Cunxin xinggong). In discerning reverence and negligence and clarifying calamities and auspicious signs, these reveal an earnest spirit of vigilance and diligence. May we hear their meaning?

There is the book True Accounts of Filial Obedience (Xiaoshun shishi), and the book Doing Good and Hidden Recompense (Weishan yinzhi). They earnestly seek to improve customs and exhort the world: can you cite one or two of their broad principles and essential points? There is the book Essential Teachings of Sagely Learning (Shengxue xinfa), and the book Complete Compendium of Human Nature and Principle (Xingli daquan). They devotedly establish moral instruction and cultivate the self: can you discern something of their subtle expressions and profound meanings? Giving order to Heaven and Earth, brilliant as the sun and stars, these are truly the writings of a dynasty. Coming to our present emperor, intelligent and sagely, who has responded to the mandate of the age by bringing about a dynastic resurgence, these qualities find expression in…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
聖謨以光宇宙如
明倫大典而萬世之綱常以定
敬一有箴五箴有註而千聖之道統以傳與夫
欽天記頌
平臺之詠雖未易殫述而至德要法巍然煥
然真有以娩美帝王同符
聖祖爲法於天下而垂之萬世者矣諸士於此
服膺有年願有以鋪張而揚厲之
問教養之道自古帝王致治之大經大法
===
也故唐虞命棄命契首於工虞夏商周
制產建學時其變通而未之有改于時
民康物阜道化宣昭後世稱盛治者必
歸焉有由然矣恭惟我
太祖高皇帝掃除腥羶正一統宇
即位之後首以農桑學校
詔天下即古帝王傳心之要此治之所以紹隆
邃古傳盛萬世者也然其宏綱大旨可
得聞乎自是蠲免天下稅糧
punctuated:
聖謨以光宇宙，如《明倫大典》，而萬世之綱常以定；敬一有箴，五箴有註，而千聖之道統以傳。與夫《欽天記頌》、平臺之詠，雖未易殫述，而至德要法，巍然煥然，真有以娩美帝王，同符聖祖，爲法於天下而垂之萬世者矣。諸士於此服膺有年，願有以鋪張而揚厲之。
問：教養之道，自古帝王致治之大經大法也。故唐虞命棄、命契，首於工虞；夏商周制產建學，時其變通，而未之有改。于時民康物阜，道化宣昭，後世稱盛治者必歸焉，有由然矣。恭惟我太祖高皇帝，掃除腥羶，正一統宇。即位之後，首以農桑學校詔天下，即古帝王傳心之要。此治之所以紹隆邃古，傳盛萬世者也。然其宏綱大旨，可得聞乎？自是蠲免天下稅糧
translation_en:
…sagely counsels that illuminate the universe. Thus the Great Compendium on Clarifying Human Relations (Minglun dadian) established the cardinal bonds and constant norms for all ages; the Admonition on Reverent Single-mindedness and the annotations to the Five Admonitions transmitted the succession of the Way through the myriad sages. Together with the Record and Eulogy of Revering Heaven (Qintian ji song) and the poems on the Platform, these writings cannot readily be recounted in full. Yet their supreme virtue and essential principles stand lofty and radiant, truly matching the excellence [?] of the ancient emperors and kings and according with the Sagely Progenitor, providing models for all under Heaven and bequeathing them to countless generations. You scholars have cherished these teachings for years; we hope that you will expound them fully and celebrate their greatness.
Question: The way of educating and nourishing the people has, since antiquity, been the fundamental principle and great method by which emperors and kings achieved good government. Thus, under Tang and Yu, the appointments of Qi 棄 and Xie 契 took precedence over those responsible for works and for mountains and forests. The Xia, Shang, and Zhou regulated livelihoods and established schools, adapting their practices to the times without changing these principles. In those days the people were secure and goods abundant, and the transforming influence of the Way shone widely. There is good reason why later generations, when speaking of flourishing government, invariably turn to these ages.
We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao swept away the rank and fetid forces and brought the realm into proper unity. After ascending the throne, he first issued edicts throughout the realm concerning agriculture, sericulture, and schools. This was precisely the essential teaching transmitted from mind to mind by the ancient emperors and kings. It is why his government continued the splendor of remote antiquity and handed down its flourishing achievements to countless generations. May we hear an account of its broad principles and essential purposes? Thereafter, the remission of land taxes in grain throughout the realm…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
詔凡幾下無非厚生之意不知深仁厚澤所以
形於播告者抑何歟至若惇庸典禮申
牖民性其出自
淵衷昭于
綸綍如
誥禮部國子監
諭太學生國學師徒
省碩文凡此皆雲漢昭回江河行地固莫可
得而議擬者也不知其開示藴奥以導
===
民之趨者其旨又何歟夫天造之初財
用宜不足而顧有餘教化宜未遑而獨
首舉其道又何繇也昔周公嘗陳公劉
后稷風化之所由以告成王豈非以守
成者之所必欲聞耶我
皇上祈天永命世德作求而於教養斯民尤惓
惓焉如
躬耕籍田時
御西苑所司奏災亟加賑貸一遇水旱竭誠祈
punctuated:
詔凡幾下，無非厚生之意。不知深仁厚澤所以形於播告者，抑何歟？至若惇庸典禮，申牖民性，其出自淵衷，昭于綸綍，如《誥禮部國子監》《諭太學生國學師徒》《省碩文》，凡此皆雲漢昭回，江河行地，固莫可得而議擬者也。不知其開示藴奥以導民之趨者，其旨又何歟？夫天造之初，財用宜不足而顧有餘，教化宜未遑而獨首舉，其道又何繇也？昔周公嘗陳公劉、后稷風化之所由，以告成王，豈非以守成者之所必欲聞耶？
我皇上祈天永命，世德作求，而於教養斯民尤惓惓焉。如躬耕籍田，時御西苑，所司奏災，亟加賑貸，一遇水旱，竭誠祈
translation_en:
…how many decrees were issued? All expressed the intention to enrich the people’s livelihood. In what ways, then, were his profound benevolence and abundant beneficence expressed in these proclamations? As for earnestly applying the established rites and further enlightening the people’s moral nature, these intentions issued from the depths of his imperial heart and were made manifest in his pronouncements, such as the Admonition to the Ministry of Rites and the Directorate of Education, the Instruction to the Students of the Imperial University and the Teachers and Pupils of the National University, and the Sheng shuo wen [?]. All these shone like the Milky Way and flowed like the great rivers across the earth; assuredly, they admit of neither criticism nor comparison. What, then, was their purport in revealing profound truths to guide the people’s course? At the founding of the dynasty, financial resources might have been expected to be insufficient, yet they were abundant; moral instruction might have been expected to await attention, yet it was undertaken first. By what means was this achieved? In former times, the Duke of Zhou explained to King Cheng the sources of the transforming moral influence of Gong Liu and Hou Ji. Was this not because such matters were precisely what a ruler preserving an inherited achievement needed to hear?
Our Emperor prays to Heaven for an enduring mandate and seeks to carry forward the virtue of successive generations. He is especially solicitous about instructing and nourishing these people. Thus he personally ploughs the imperial ploughing field and from time to time visits the Western Park. When the responsible officials report a disaster, he promptly increases relief grants and loans. Whenever flood or drought occurs, he prays with utmost sincerity…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
省且又
親灑宸翰頒布學宮申飭中外明著章程瀹鳌
文體一歸於正所以勸天下之農而教
天下之士上符
皇祖而緝熙宥密貞出周成王之上矣然其
躬行於上而以創以承風行於下而以足以明
必有本焉又不專以經綸之迹求之也
諸士子盍敬陳之以表芹曝之悃
問周官設馮相氏保章氏之職專以掌紀
===
歲月日時其義攸在而孟子亦以爲苟
求其已然之迹千歲之日至如指諸掌
則雖天辰高遠亦有可知之理蓋治曆
明時乃聖王之所先而曆家測天之說
亦吾儒之所不可忽焉者也粤自黄帝
迎日推筴以來代嘗有之其間或略或
詳不知當時所司者何人而所指者何
事漢之曆凡五變何者稱善唐之曆凡
八變何者爲優宋曆未嘗不當至元郭
punctuated:
省，且又親灑宸翰，頒布學宮，申飭中外，明著章程，瀹鳌文體，一歸於正。所以勸天下之農，而教天下之士，上符皇祖，而緝熙宥密，貞出周成王之上矣。然其躬行於上，而以創以承；風行於下，而以足以明，必有本焉，又不專以經綸之迹求之也。諸士子盍敬陳之，以表芹曝之悃？
問：周官設馮相氏、保章氏之職，專以掌紀歲月日時，其義攸在。而孟子亦以爲，苟求其已然之迹，千歲之日至，如指諸掌。則雖天辰高遠，亦有可知之理。蓋治曆明時，乃聖王之所先，而曆家測天之說，亦吾儒之所不可忽焉者也。粤自黄帝迎日推筴以來，代嘗有之。其間或略或詳，不知當時所司者何人，而所指者何事？漢之曆凡五變，何者稱善？唐之曆凡八變，何者爲優？宋曆未嘗不當，至元郭
translation_en:
…and examines himself. Moreover, he personally wields the imperial brush and distributes his writings to the schools, issues admonitions to officials within and outside the capital, and clearly promulgates regulations, reforming literary style [?] so that it returns entirely to correctness. In thus encouraging the farmers of the realm and instructing its scholars, he accords with his imperial ancestor above; his virtue, continuously bright and profoundly tranquil, indeed [?] surpasses that of King Cheng of Zhou. Yet there must be a foundation for his personal conduct above, through which he both establishes and perpetuates these undertakings, and for its influence spreading below, through which the people attain sufficiency and enlightenment. This foundation cannot be sought solely in the outward traces of his ordering of affairs. Why do you candidates not respectfully expound it, expressing your humble sincerity, like those who offered celery or the warmth of the sun?
Question: The Offices of Zhou established the posts of Astrologer (Fengxiang shi) and Astronomer (Baozhang shi), specifically charged with recording the years, months, days, and hours; there was significance in this arrangement. Mencius likewise held that, if one sought out the traces of what had already occurred, determining the solstices a thousand years hence would be as easy as pointing to one's palm. Thus, although the heavenly bodies are lofty and distant, there are principles by which they can be understood. Regulating the calendar and making the seasons clear were priorities of the sage kings, and the explanations of celestial measurement offered by calendrical specialists are likewise matters that we Confucian scholars must not neglect. Ever since the Yellow Emperor observed the sun's coming and calculated with counting rods, successive ages have had such practices. Some were sketchy, others detailed. Who were the officials responsible at those times, and what matters did these practices concern? The Han calendar underwent five changes: which was considered sound? The Tang calendar underwent eight changes: which was superior? The Song calendars were by no means inaccurate, but when it came to Guo of the Yuan…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
守敬而其術愈精
國家大統曆多或取之豈亦理之所在不以
勝國而可廢耶曆家之議有日躔月離
有氣朔盈虛有日法斗分有閏餘歲差
執此以求豈各有分而不可混耶先儒
謂曆法大抵主於日月又謂於日月交
感之際以陰陽質之方得不差然則數
果有一定而不忒耶夫定曆固在於明
陰陽至要莫先於精差法說者謂差法
===
之精其道有四得人爲本立元繼之測
候次之準古又次之誠由是而精之則
驗其數於杪忽毫釐之積分觀其象於
日月星辰之躔度徵其氣於寒暑晝夜
之往來以辨敍事以詔救政曆法明而
治道出矣關係於世豈曰小補之哉執
事者願有聞也
問士儒脩於家而効用於世也其大要所
需有二曰德器曰才識二者不容或偏
punctuated:
守敬，而其術愈精。國家大統曆多或取之，豈亦理之所在，不以勝國而可廢耶？曆家之議，有日躔月離，有氣朔盈虛，有日法斗分，有閏餘歲差，執此以求，豈各有分而不可混耶？先儒謂曆法大抵主於日月，又謂於日月交感之際，以陰陽質之，方得不差。然則數果有一定而不忒耶？夫定曆固在於明陰陽，至要莫先於精差法。說者謂差法之精，其道有四：得人爲本，立元繼之，測候次之，準古又次之。誠由是而精之，則驗其數於杪忽毫釐之積分，觀其象於日月星辰之躔度，徵其氣於寒暑晝夜之往來，以辨敍事，以詔救政，曆法明而治道出矣。關係於世，豈曰小補之哉？執事者願有聞也。
問：士儒脩於家而効用於世也，其大要所需有二：曰德器，曰才識。二者不容或偏。
translation_en:
…Shoujing, whose techniques became still more precise. Our dynasty’s Great Concordance Calendar draws extensively upon them. Is this not also because, wherever sound principles reside, they cannot be discarded merely because they come from a preceding dynasty? Calendar specialists discuss the sun’s course and the moon’s motion, the solar terms and new moons and their excesses and deficits, the day divisor and the fractional remainder of the year, and the intercalary remainder and precession. In investigating these, does each not have its distinct province, so that they must not be confused? Earlier Confucian scholars said that calendrical methods chiefly concern the sun and moon. They also said that, at the junctures where the sun and moon interact, one must examine them through yin and yang to avoid error. Are the numerical values, then, truly fixed and unfailing?
Establishing a calendar certainly depends upon understanding yin and yang, but nothing is more essential than perfecting the methods of correction. Commentators say that there are four ways to perfect these methods: obtaining the right people is fundamental; establishing an epoch comes next; observation follows; and comparison with antiquity follows that. If precision is truly pursued in this way, one can verify the numerical values through the accumulation of the minutest fractions, observe celestial configurations through the degrees traversed by the sun, moon, and stars, and confirm seasonal influences through the alternation of cold and heat, day and night. These serve to distinguish and order affairs and to provide guidance for corrective measures in government. Once calendrical methods are understood, the way of good government emerges. Given their bearing upon the world, could their contribution be called slight? We who administer this examination would welcome your explanation.
Question: Scholars cultivate themselves at home and render service in the world. Broadly speaking, they require two things: moral character and capacity, and ability and judgment. Neither may be favored at the expense of the other.

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
蓋有德者必有才有才者未嘗不本於
德故孔子曰君子不器然亦有不能盡
然者嘗夷考古今人物而因論其才德
每每有不能相爲流通者焉試與諸士
子評之度越諸子者胡爲乎著論美新
振頽八代者胡爲乎上書干進其氣節
不無有歉身任阿衡者而或少乎持滿
之戒功在社稷者而循略於蜀鏡之荅
其學術在所當急治行第一而功名損
===
於爲郡務養名節而就職卒無建白豈
事業有難易歟有王佐之器而將略非
其所長有忠義之心而才力有所不逮
豈知受有大小歟精忠勁節力扶漢運
者或昧聲討之權建功立業宣力唐室
者或蒙事讎之恥或重厚而不知錢穀
之數或純謹而不識剛正之字或以諫
諍鳴於時而拙於徵科或以文章重於
世而失於所從然此皆才德不能以兼
punctuated: 蓋有德者必有才，有才者未嘗不本於德。故孔子曰：「君子不器。」然亦有不能盡然者。嘗夷考古今人物，而因論其才德，每每有不能相爲流通者焉。試與諸士子評之：度越諸子者，胡爲乎著論美新？振頽八代者，胡爲乎上書干進？其氣節不無有歉。身任阿衡者，而或少乎持滿之戒；功在社稷者，而循略於蜀鏡之荅。其學術在所當急。治行第一，而功名損於爲郡；務養名節，而就職卒無建白。豈事業有難易歟？有王佐之器，而將略非其所長；有忠義之心，而才力有所不逮。豈知受有大小歟？精忠勁節、力扶漢運者，或昧聲討之權；建功立業、宣力唐室者，或蒙事讎之恥；或重厚而不知錢穀之數；或純謹而不識剛正之字；或以諫諍鳴於時，而拙於徵科；或以文章重於世，而失於所從。然此皆才德不能以兼
translation_en: For those who possess virtue must possess ability, and ability has never been without a foundation in virtue. Thus Confucius said, “The gentleman is not a mere vessel.” Yet there are cases in which this does not hold entirely true. Upon examining impartially the figures of antiquity and the present, and assessing their ability and virtue, one repeatedly finds that the two fail to work in concert. Let us consider these cases together, candidates: why did one who surpassed the various masters write a discourse praising the Xin dynasty? Why did one who revived literary accomplishment after eight dynasties of decline submit letters seeking advancement? Their moral resolve and integrity were not without shortcomings. One who assumed the responsibilities of chief minister (aheng) perhaps lacked the caution needed to preserve his position at the height of success; another, whose achievements sustained the state, was cursory in his reply concerning the mirror of Shu [?]. Their learning called for urgent attention. One ranked first in administrative performance, yet diminished his achievements and reputation while governing a commandery; another devoted himself to cultivating his reputation and integrity, yet, upon taking office, ultimately offered no proposals. Could it be that undertakings differ in difficulty? One had the capacity to assist a true king, yet military strategy was not his strength; another had a loyal and righteous heart, yet his abilities and strength fell short. Could it be that intellectual endowments differ in measure [?]? One of consummate loyalty and unyielding integrity, who strove to uphold the fortunes of the Han, perhaps failed to understand the judicious use of public denunciation; another, who established great achievements and exerted himself for the Tang ruling house, incurred the shame of serving an enemy. Some were dignified and substantial, yet did not understand fiscal accounts; some were upright and circumspect, yet did not recognize the very words “firmness and rectitude.” Some became renowned in their day for remonstrance, yet were inept at collecting taxes; some were esteemed throughout the world for their writings, yet erred in choosing whom to follow. Yet all these were cases in which ability and virtue could not both be …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
全豈德與才有二也耶諸士子博古通
今者也願悉陳之以觀尚友之學
問世之言善治者在得人以分任衆職務
使天下之民舉安而後可也公卿而下
孰非任職之人然稱至要而近民唯守
與令焉豈以內外之體有相關歟夫亦
爲民之師帥所以承流而宣化者非彼
有不能歟黷貨而淫刑者戕衆性庸而
才劣者佐姦執拗而乖方者僨事望風
===
而頋指者敗紀咸足爲有位之蠹民將
奚所賴歟或有以治圃喻足用種樹喻
任人而又以役使非時善斂課最爲戒
釋而行之不識有宜於民否歟職政所
在理效不殊漢傳所紀獨詳守相凡令
若長略而不書豈爲邑者績用之不逮
於郡歟紀有詳略宜人無所於勸乃稱
漢治獨爲近古抑又何所據歟迨宋天
聖熙寧以至於元祐相繼而共事益衆
punctuated:
全，豈德與才有二也耶？諸士子博古通今者也，願悉陳之，以觀尚友之學。

問：世之言善治者，在得人以分任衆職，務使天下之民舉安而後可也。公卿而下，孰非任職之人？然稱至要而近民，唯守與令焉，豈以內外之體有相關歟？夫亦爲民之師帥，所以承流而宣化者，非彼有不能歟？黷貨而淫刑者戕衆，性庸而才劣者佐姦，執拗而乖方者僨事，望風而頋指者敗紀，咸足爲有位之蠹，民將奚所賴歟？或有以治圃喻足用、種樹喻任人，而又以役使非時、善斂課最爲戒。釋而行之，不識有宜於民否歟？職政所在，理效不殊，漢傳所紀獨詳守相，凡令若長，略而不書，豈爲邑者績用之不逮於郡歟？紀有詳略，宜人無所於勸，乃稱漢治獨爲近古，抑又何所據歟？迨宋天聖、熙寧，以至於元祐，相繼而共事益衆
translation_en:
…both in full. Can virtue and talent really be two separate things? You candidates are widely versed in antiquity and conversant with the present. We ask you to set forth your views fully, so that we may assess your learning in taking the ancients as your friends.

Question: Those who discuss good government in this age hold that it consists in obtaining suitable men to share responsibility for the many offices; only when all the people under Heaven have been brought to peace can this suffice. From dukes and ministers downward, who does not bear the responsibilities of office? Yet those said to be most essential and closest to the people are the prefects and district magistrates alone. Is this because the institutions of central and local government are interconnected? Or is it also because, as the people's teachers and leaders, they perform an indispensable role in receiving and transmitting the transforming influence of government? Those who crave wealth and impose excessive punishments harm the multitude; those of mediocre character and inferior ability abet wrongdoing; those who are obstinate and act improperly ruin affairs; those who watch which way the wind blows and look for signals from above undermine discipline. All can become pests among the officeholders. On whom, then, can the people rely? Some have used tending a vegetable garden as an analogy for ensuring sufficient resources, and planting trees as an analogy for employing men. They have also warned against requisitioning labor at improper times and awarding the highest performance ratings for skill in exacting revenue. If these ideas are interpreted and put into practice, would they benefit the people? Wherever administrative responsibilities lie, the results of good government should not differ. Yet the biographies in the History of the Han give detailed accounts only of governors and chancellors of princedoms, while magistrates and chiefs of districts are passed over without being recorded. Could the achievements of those governing districts have fallen short of those governing commanderies? Since the records vary in detail, one might expect men to lack encouragement [?]. Yet Han government alone is praised as approaching that of antiquity. On what grounds is this claim made? By the successive Tiansheng and Xining reign periods of the Song, and onward to Yuanyou, those sharing in the work of government became ever more numerous…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
其任益重矣所以爲善者比之於漢果
相類歟
明興設官分職雖各攸重而於守令尤加意焉
愛養元元至優渥也是以我
太祖高皇帝乃於有司超羣者十有餘員
嘉勞賜級彰往而勸來凡以爲民也其詳可
得言歟自是而後寖以無聞豈有之而
不著抑人之難得而職司者之弗稱歟
玆欲各舉其職使天下之爲守若令者
===
皆賢以免民愁歎之聲仰副我
皇上視民如傷之心不可謂世無其人也然則
何道可以致之歟幸相與講求其故將
以告於今之司民牧者
punctuated:
其任益重矣，所以爲善者，比之於漢，果相類歟？

明興，設官分職，雖各攸重，而於守令尤加意焉。愛養元元，至優渥也。是以我太祖高皇帝乃於有司超羣者十有餘員，嘉勞賜級，彰往而勸來，凡以爲民也。其詳可得言歟？自是而後，寖以無聞，豈有之而不著，抑人之難得，而職司者之弗稱歟？玆欲各舉其職，使天下之爲守若令者皆賢，以免民愁歎之聲，仰副我皇上視民如傷之心，不可謂世無其人也。然則何道可以致之歟？幸相與講求其故，將以告於今之司民牧者。
translation_en:
…their responsibilities grew ever weightier. Were the means by which they governed well truly comparable to those of the Han?

When the Ming arose, it established offices and apportioned duties. Although each had its own importance, particular attention was devoted to prefects and district magistrates. Its loving care for the common people was most generous. Thus our Emperor Taizu Gao commended and rewarded more than ten outstanding officials of the local administration, granting them advancement in rank, honoring past service and encouraging future effort—all for the people's sake. Can you relate the details? Since then, such instances have gradually ceased to be heard of. Have they occurred but gone unrecorded, or have worthy men been difficult to find, so that those holding office have failed to measure up?

We now wish each official to discharge his duties, so that all who serve as prefects or district magistrates throughout the realm may be worthy, sparing the people cries of sorrow and lamentation and fulfilling our Emperor's concern for them, as though they were injured. We cannot say that the age lacks such men. By what means, then, can this be achieved? Please investigate the reasons together, so that the findings may be conveyed to those who shepherd the people today.

而難於用功聖道之妙之至也大賢發歎至此
非學旣有得而深知之者能然乎昔者顏淵學
孔子之道蓋欲進於孔子也三月不違固有徵
於請事斯語之後矣當乎未領其要也而進之
則患於無由者其視道固惟有見於高妙之難
求耳乃喟然發歎以爲夫子之道自其峻然者
punctuated:
第壹場
四書
「仰之彌高，鑽之彌堅，瞻之在前，忽焉在後。」
劉淮

大賢極歎聖道之妙，而其所得可知矣。夫求道而難於用功，聖道之妙之至也。大賢發歎至此，非學旣有得而深知之者能然乎？昔者顏淵學孔子之道，蓋欲進於孔子也。三月不違，固有徵於請事斯語之後矣。當乎未領其要也，而進之則患於無由者，其視道固惟有見於高妙之難求耳。乃喟然發歎，以爲夫子之道，自其峻然者
translation_en:
First Session
Four Books
“The more I look up to it, the higher it rises; the more I bore into it, the harder it becomes. I behold it before me, and suddenly it is behind me.”
Liu Huai

Associate Examiner Li, Instructor, comments: “Those who explain the passages about height, hardness, before, and behind are often tiresomely disjointed. Your composition alone shows an intimate grasp, without a single superfluous phrase. Might you be one who has learned from Yan and gained something thereby? It is for this that I select it.”

Associate Examiner Hu, Instructor, comments: “This is precisely the meaning of ‘the Mean cannot be practiced,’ manifested particularly in the passages about height, hardness, before, and behind. Reading your essay, I find that it could rank first not merely in Zhongzhou [?].”

Examiner Zheng, Instructor, comments: “An incisive and thorough explanation of Master Yan’s admiration for the wondrousness of the sage’s Way.”

Examiner Qu, Instructor, comments: “Dignified and worthy of serving as a model.”

The great worthy expressed the utmost admiration for the wondrousness of the sage’s Way, and from this we may know what he had attained. To seek the Way yet find it difficult to apply one’s efforts—this shows the supreme wondrousness of the sage’s Way. Could the great worthy have voiced such admiration unless he had already attained something through learning and understood it deeply? In former times, Yan Yuan studied the Way of Kongzi, seeking to advance to Kongzi’s level. That for three months he did not depart from benevolence was indeed evidence of his attainment after he had asked to put those words into practice. Yet while he had not grasped its essentials, and was troubled that he had no means of advancing, he saw in the Way only its lofty wondrousness and the difficulty of pursuing it. Thus he sighed deeply in admiration, thinking that, as for the Master’s Way, viewed in its towering aspect …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
而觀之則云高矣然非高以絶人也吾嘗景慕
以求其端焉則仰之莫及如不可階升者顔彌
高而上達之未易能歟自其渾然者而觀之則
云堅矣然非堅以拒人也吾嘗研慮以窺其内
焉則鑚之莫入如不可貫通者顔彌堅而聖域
之未易造歟何者夫子道之管也崇效乎天而
天下莫能載精入於微而天下莫能破是道之
無窮盡有如此吾將何如以爲功耶以至凝神
於心目之間瞻之若可覩矣而神應無方不可
===
典要者則不恒在於前誠定向之難求雖欲與
之偕行而不可得也其顯微無間者焉注思於
感通之際引眇若在前矣而變易無體唯變所
適者則忽移於其後實擬議之莫定雖欲與之
游衍而不可能也其動静無端者焉何者夫子
道之會也參乎其前而步之不可瞠乎其後而
趨之不可是道之無方體有如此吾將何如以
用力耶吁此固顔子求之切故有見於用功之
難然非知之深亦豈能發歎之若是哉雖然夫
punctuated: 而觀之，則云高矣。然非高以絶人也。吾嘗景慕以求其端焉，則仰之莫及，如不可階升者，顔彌高，而上達之未易能歟？自其渾然者而觀之，則云堅矣。然非堅以拒人也。吾嘗研慮以窺其内焉，則鑚之莫入，如不可貫通者，顔彌堅，而聖域之未易造歟？何者？夫子，道之管也。崇效乎天，而天下莫能載；精入於微，而天下莫能破。是道之無窮盡有如此，吾將何如以爲功耶？以至凝神於心目之間，瞻之若可覩矣，而神應無方、不可典要者，則不恒在於前，誠定向之難求，雖欲與之偕行而不可得也，其顯微無間者焉。注思於感通之際，引眇若在前矣，而變易無體、唯變所適者，則忽移於其後，實擬議之莫定，雖欲與之游衍而不可能也，其動静無端者焉。何者？夫子，道之會也。參乎其前，而步之不可；瞠乎其後，而趨之不可。是道之無方體有如此，吾將何如以用力耶？吁！此固顔子求之切，故有見於用功之難，然非知之深，亦豈能發歎之若是哉？雖然，夫
translation_en:
…when viewed in this aspect, it may be called lofty. Yet its loftiness does not exclude others. I have looked up to it in admiration, seeking a point of entry, but when I gaze upward I cannot reach it, as though there were no steps by which to ascend. It seems ever higher [?]: is attaining the higher understanding truly so difficult? Viewed in its undivided wholeness, it may be called firm. Yet its firmness does not repel others. I have pondered deeply to glimpse its interior, but when I bore into it I cannot enter, as though it could not be penetrated. It seems ever firmer [?]: is reaching the realm of sagehood truly so difficult? Why is this? The Master is the conduit of the Way [?]. His loftiness matches Heaven, and nothing under Heaven can bear it; his refinement enters into the most subtle, and nothing under Heaven can break through it. Such is the inexhaustibility of the Way. How, then, am I to make progress?

Moreover, concentrating my spirit within my mind and vision, I look toward it as though it could be seen. Yet its wondrous responses have no fixed direction and cannot be confined to established rules, so it does not remain constantly before me. Truly, a fixed direction is difficult to find: even if I wished to move together with it, I could not. Such is its seamless continuity between the manifest and the subtle. Focusing my thoughts upon the moment of responsive communion, I strain my distant gaze [?], as though it were before me. Yet its transformations have no fixed form and follow wherever change leads, so it suddenly shifts behind me. Truly, reflection and deliberation can find nothing settled: even if I wished to wander freely with it, I could not. Such is its lack of any fixed beginning in movement or stillness. Why is this? The Master is where the Way converges. It stands before me, yet I cannot follow it at a walk; I stare after it, yet I cannot catch it by hastening. Such is the Way’s lack of fixed direction or form. How, then, am I to exert myself?

Ah! It was certainly because Master Yan sought it so earnestly that he perceived the difficulty of applying himself. Yet without understanding it deeply, how could he have sighed in this way? Nevertheless, the Master…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
子之道根於天命人心之正散於人倫日用之
常不越乎中庸而已夫何高堅前後之有顏氏
之歎蓋藉是以歎中庸之不可能也博文約禮
則所以示人知所趨而一乎高堅前後者也既
竭吾才所立卓爾固駸駸乎上達之幾而中庸
其在我矣又何有於仰鑽瞻忽之難哉惜也止
於具體而微而不免於一間之未達則天也非
人也
誠之者擇善而固執之者也
何思
===
同考試官教諭鄭　批〔辭無枝蔓而理自足中庸〕
義宜如此作
考試官教諭鄭　批〔典實可錄以式〕
考試官教諭曲　批〔明暢〕
中庸申言誠之者之功惟致夫精一而已蓋理
欲雜而實德鮮矣察之必精而守之必一焉則
實德在我而誠者之地豈難至哉誠之者之道
有如此夫子之答魯君其意以爲性命於天本
punctuated:
子之道，根於天命人心之正，散於人倫日用之常，不越乎中庸而已。夫何高堅前後之有？顏氏之歎，蓋藉是以歎中庸之不可能也。博文約禮，則所以示人知所趨，而一乎高堅前後者也。既竭吾才，所立卓爾，固駸駸乎上達之幾，而中庸其在我矣，又何有於仰鑽瞻忽之難哉？惜也，止於具體而微，而不免於一間之未達，則天也，非人也。
「誠之者，擇善而固執之者也。」
何思
同考試官教諭鄭　批〔辭無枝蔓，而理自足。中庸〕義宜如此作。
考試官教諭鄭　批〔典實可錄以式〕
考試官教諭曲　批〔明暢〕
《中庸》申言誠之者之功，惟致夫精一而已。蓋理欲雜，而實德鮮矣。察之必精，而守之必一焉，則實德在我，而誠者之地豈難至哉？誠之者之道有如此。夫子之答魯君，其意以爲性命於天，本
translation_en:
…the Master's Way is rooted in the rectitude of Heaven's mandate and the human heart, and extends throughout the ordinary affairs of human relationships and daily life. It does not go beyond the Mean. What, then, is there that is lofty or hard, ahead or behind? Yan Hui's sigh was surely a means of lamenting the difficulty of practicing the Mean. Broadening one's learning through literature and restraining oneself through ritual show people the direction to pursue and unite what seems lofty or hard, ahead or behind. Having exhausted all his abilities, he saw it standing卓然—toweringly—before him: he was indeed advancing toward the threshold of higher understanding, with the Mean within his grasp. What difficulty would then remain in looking upward, drilling into it, or seeking it now ahead and suddenly behind? Alas, he possessed the whole in miniature, yet still fell one interval short of full attainment. This was due to Heaven, not to human effort.
“The person who makes himself sincere chooses what is good and holds firmly to it.”
He Si
Associate Examiner Zheng, Instructor, comments: “The language has no extraneous branches, yet the reasoning is complete in itself. Essays on the meaning of the Doctrine of the Mean should be written in this manner.”
Examiner Zheng, Instructor, comments: “Grounded in the classics and substantial; worthy of inclusion as a model.”
Examiner Qu, Instructor, comments: “Clear and fluent.”
The Doctrine of the Mean further explains that the work of making oneself sincere consists solely in attaining discrimination and single-mindedness. For moral principle and desire become intermingled, and genuine virtue is rare. One must examine them with discrimination and hold fast with single-mindedness. Then genuine virtue will reside within oneself, and how could the state of one who is sincere be difficult to attain? Such is the way of making oneself sincere. In answering the ruler of Lu, the Master's meaning was that one's nature is endowed by Heaven, and originally…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
無不實之理性鑿於情始有不實之心去其僞
以存乎誠復其同以變乎異是固所謂誠之者
而爲人之道矣然果何如以爲功哉蓋不思而
得固聖人之能事也而未逮乎此者不有以擇
之則欲易得以間矣必精以致察焉有一念之
發則辨是與非何者而爲天命之本然務使昭
晰於中已私弗得以混淆之也如是則能擇矣
善不由是而明乎不勉而中固誠者之自然也
而未及乎此者不有以執之則僞易得以參矣
===
必一以致守焉有一善之得則服膺弗失確乎
以全人心之固有務使貞固不變外物弗得以
搖奪之也如是則能執矣身不由是而誠乎是
則能擇善則知足以及而有以啓誠之之端能
固執則仁足以守而有以致誠之之實此固天
人合一之學所謂成功則一之道也公共知之
乎抑斯道也堯舜以來相傳之道也夫子舉之
以語魯君者蓋以入聖之道望魯君耳惜乎魯
君自諉於不足而竟使夫子徒托之空言也雖
punctuated: 無不實之理。性鑿於情，始有不實之心。去其僞以存乎誠，復其同以變乎異，是固所謂誠之者而爲人之道矣。然果何如以爲功哉？蓋不思而得，固聖人之能事也；而未逮乎此者，不有以擇之，則欲易得以間矣。必精以致察焉，有一念之發，則辨是與非，何者而爲天命之本然，務使昭晰於中，已私弗得以混淆之也。如是則能擇矣，善不由是而明乎？不勉而中，固誠者之自然也；而未及乎此者，不有以執之，則僞易得以參矣。必一以致守焉，有一善之得，則服膺弗失，確乎以全人心之固有，務使貞固不變，外物弗得以搖奪之也。如是則能執矣，身不由是而誠乎？是則能擇善，則知足以及，而有以啓誠之之端；能固執，則仁足以守，而有以致誠之之實。此固天人合一之學，所謂成功則一之道也。公共知之乎？抑斯道也，堯舜以來相傳之道也。夫子舉之以語魯君者，蓋以入聖之道望魯君耳。惜乎魯君自諉於不足，而竟使夫子徒托之空言也。雖
translation_en:
…there is no principle that is not real and true. Only when human nature is impaired by the feelings does insincerity arise in the mind. To remove falsity and preserve sincerity, to restore what is shared and thereby transform what differs: this is precisely what is called making oneself sincere, the way of being human. But how, in practice, is this work to be accomplished? Attaining understanding without reflection is indeed a capacity of the sage. Yet those who have not reached this point, unless they have a means of choosing, readily allow desires to intrude. They must exercise refinement to bring discernment to its fullest extent. Whenever a thought arises, they must distinguish right from wrong and discern what accords with the original character of Heaven’s mandate. They must ensure that this is clearly understood within, so that selfish interests [?] cannot confuse it. In this way they become capable of choosing. Does not goodness thereby become clear?

Hitting the mark without effort is indeed natural to one who is sincere. Yet those who have not reached this point, unless they have a means of holding fast, readily allow falsity to enter. They must exercise singleness to bring their steadfastness to its fullest extent. Whenever they apprehend something good, they must cherish it in their hearts without losing it, firmly preserving in its entirety what is inherent in the human mind. They must ensure that it remains steadfast and unchanging, so that external things cannot shake or wrest it away. In this way they become capable of holding fast. Does not the self thereby become sincere?

Thus, if one can choose the good, one’s knowledge is sufficient to reach it, providing a means to begin making oneself sincere. If one can hold firmly to it, one’s benevolence is sufficient to preserve it, providing a means to bring the substance of sincerity to fulfillment. This is indeed the learning through which Heaven and humanity become one—the way expressed in the saying, “When success is achieved, it is one and the same.” Does Your Lordship understand this? [?]

Moreover, this way is the way transmitted from the time of Yao and Shun onward. When the Master raised it in speaking to the ruler of Lu, he did so because he hoped the ruler would follow the way to sagehood. Alas, the ruler of Lu excused himself on grounds of inadequacy and ultimately left the Master to entrust it merely to empty words. Although…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
然自斯言出而思孟傳之厥後宋儒繼之而吾
道得以不墜是夫子雖未行於魯而固行於天
下後世也哉後之學者其尚知所求乎
得天下英才而教育之三樂也
中嘉瑞
同考試官教諭崔　批〔雅健而不浮　舂容而不滯〕
同考試官學正林　批〔有理致有醞　藉是用錄之〕
殆中州之英才歟
考試官教諭鄭　批〔讀之充　如可錄〕
===
考試官教諭曲　批〔平　順〕
得人以溥斯道之傳君子澤世之心慰矣蓋君
子者有世道之責者也斯道之傳而盡得其人
焉則澤之所及也遠矣其樂寧容已乎昔孟子
立言之意以爲體萬物而不遺者君子之道曠
百世而相感者君子之心故君子既樂得其道
矣而豈如是止耶蓋道者天下之公英才者傳
道之器也如其道既我得矣風聲所感而天下
之廣凡負明睿之資者罔不相率以宗予教自
punctuated:
然，自斯言出，而思孟傳之厥後，宋儒繼之，而吾道得以不墜。是夫子雖未行於魯，而固行於天下後世也哉！後之學者，其尚知所求乎？
得天下英才而教育之，三樂也。
中嘉瑞

考試官教諭鄭批〔讀之充　如可錄〕
