Consider Wang Zun as governor of Anding: he issued instructions to the subordinate counties, telling them to understand and attend carefully to their duties and not personally put the law to the test. When Zhu Bo served as regional inspector of Jizhou, he had two county magistrates exchange counties, reassigning them because they possessed ability but were not fulfilling their duties. Xue Xuan likewise held that a regional inspector should scrutinize the senior local officials who wore black seal-ribbons. Thus it is the governor who instructs them, the governor who assigns them, and again the governor who scrutinizes them. Then superiors and subordinates mutually…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
維政事自學史稱漢治之近古不足徵於
此耶迨至於宋損鎮將之權而其事益舉
選京朝之官而其任益重宋治之過於詳
愼此其意蓋有在矣蓋天下至廣也人民
至多也其利其害其安其危豈能家喻而
户至哉誠能得一賢守以統於其上則爲
令若長有所仰承膏澤日下小民將無所
不被矣故民不得盡愛得一賢令足矣令
不能盡知得一賢守足矣此宋所以獨重
===
乎郡要以郡之職任或優於邑耶觀天聖
之詔則欲守臣歲舉縣令一人以備選用
熙寜之法則欲知州課縣令三條以侯黜
陟元祐之制則欲守倅察縣令四善以明
殿最夫舉之者守課之者守察之者又守
也則尊卑相統綱紀自張史稱宋法之獨
善不有驗於此耶執事謂職任之舉郡雖
重於邑愚則爲事體之屬令無異於守何
者天下一身也郡猶臂也令猶指也身之
punctuated: 維，政事自學，史稱漢治之近古，不足徵於此耶？迨至於宋，損鎮將之權，而其事益舉；選京朝之官，而其任益重。宋治之過於詳愼，此其意蓋有在矣。蓋天下至廣也，人民至多也，其利其害，其安其危，豈能家喻而户至哉？誠能得一賢守以統於其上，則爲令若長有所仰承，膏澤日下，小民將無所不被矣。故民不得盡愛，得一賢令足矣；令不能盡知，得一賢守足矣。此宋所以獨重乎郡，要以郡之職任或優於邑耶？觀天聖之詔，則欲守臣歲舉縣令一人以備選用；熙寜之法，則欲知州課縣令三條以侯黜陟；元祐之制，則欲守倅察縣令四善以明殿最。夫舉之者守，課之者守，察之者又守也，則尊卑相統，綱紀自張。史稱宋法之獨善，不有驗於此耶？執事謂職任之舉，郡雖重於邑，愚則爲事體之屬，令無異於守。何者？天下一身也，郡猶臂也，令猶指也，身之
translation_en:
…bound together, governmental affairs naturally learned [?]. Is this not sufficient evidence for the histories’ claim that Han government approached that of antiquity? By the Song, the powers of regional military commanders were curtailed, and administrative affairs were better attended to; capital officials were selected for these posts, and their responsibilities became weightier. There was surely a reason for the exceptional thoroughness and caution of Song government. The realm is vast and its people numerous: how could one explain matters to every household and visit every door to learn what benefits or harms them, what makes them secure or imperils them? If one can obtain a single worthy prefect to exercise authority above them, county magistrates and chiefs will have someone to look up to and obey. Beneficence will flow down daily, reaching all the common people. Thus, when one cannot care personally for all the people, obtaining one worthy county magistrate is enough; when one cannot know all the county magistrates, obtaining one worthy prefect is enough. Was the Song’s particular emphasis on prefectures ultimately based on the view that prefectural responsibilities perhaps outweighed those of counties?
Consider the edict of the Tiansheng era: it called upon prefects to recommend one county magistrate each year for selection and appointment. The regulations of the Xining era called upon prefects to assess county magistrates according to three criteria, pending [?] demotion or promotion. The system of the Yuanyou era called upon prefects and vice prefects to examine county magistrates according to the Four Merits, so as to distinguish inferior from superior performance. It was the prefect who recommended them, the prefect who assessed them, and again the prefect who scrutinized them. Thus superiors and subordinates were linked under a common authority, and administrative order naturally prevailed. Does this not substantiate the histories’ claim that Song institutions were exceptionally good?
You maintain that, in the discharge of official responsibilities, prefectures carry greater weight than counties. In my humble view, however, in the interconnected workings of government, a county magistrate is no different from a prefect. Why? The realm is a single body; prefectures are like its arms, and county magistrates like its fingers. The body’s…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
使臂臂之使指係於血脉之貫通淤之則
病生天下之有郡郡之有邑實則事體之
聯屬觖之則民病豈俟智者而後知哉
明興用人圖治各有攸司而於守令親民之官
尤加意焉愛養元元至優渥也我
太祖高皇帝是以於有司超擢者
嘉勞賜級以爲臣民之激勸者蓋十有餘員
焉是故陳希文爲懷寧縣縣丞則因指揮
圖民地而執法不從是以有太守之擢王
===
復春爲宜興縣主簿因本府不公事而陳
論不避是以有同知之轉李善陸鑑皆縣
佐也一則以弊政事聞而即升爲同知一
則劾旗軍害民而即擢爲通判畢輝王搏
奏旗軍持正道而拜夫尊酒之
賜此縣官之守正爲何如王禘賢陳維賢
奏舍人馳當道而蒙夫尊酒之
勞此郡守之執法爲何如至於父老詣
闕陳情而得復本官者非朱允恭知諸城之爲
punctuated:
使臂，臂之使指，係於血脉之貫通，淤之則病生。天下之有郡，郡之有邑，實則事體之聯屬，觖之則民病，豈俟智者而後知哉？

明興，用人圖治，各有攸司，而於守令親民之官尤加意焉，愛養元元至優渥也。我太祖高皇帝是以於有司超擢者，嘉勞賜級，以爲臣民之激勸者，蓋十有餘員焉。是故陳希文爲懷寧縣縣丞，則因指揮圖民地而執法不從，是以有太守之擢。王復春爲宜興縣主簿，因本府不公事而陳論不避，是以有同知之轉。李善、陸鑑皆縣佐也，一則以弊政事聞而即升爲同知，一則劾旗軍害民而即擢爲通判。畢輝、王搏奏旗軍，持正道，而拜夫尊酒之賜，此縣官之守正爲何如？王禘賢、陳維賢奏舍人馳當道，而蒙夫尊酒之勞，此郡守之執法爲何如？至於父老詣闕陳情而得復本官者，非朱允恭知諸城之爲
translation_en:
…the body's directing the arms, and the arms' directing the fingers, depend upon the uninterrupted flow of blood through the vessels; obstruct it, and illness arises. The realm's division into prefectures, and prefectures' division into counties, likewise rests upon the interconnection of administrative affairs. Break that connection, and the people suffer. Must one wait for a wise man to recognize this?

When the Ming arose, it employed men in pursuit of good government, each with his assigned responsibilities. It devoted particular attention to prefects and magistrates, the officials closest to the people, and was most generous in nurturing the common folk. Thus our Emperor Taizu Gao commended meritorious service and bestowed higher ranks upon more than ten officials whom he promoted exceptionally, thereby encouraging his subjects and officials. When Chen Xiwen was assistant magistrate of Huaining County, a military commander sought to seize the people's land; Chen upheld the law and refused to comply, and was consequently promoted to prefect. When Wang Fuchun was registrar of Yixing County, he spoke out fearlessly about unjust dealings in his prefectural administration, and was consequently transferred to the post of vice prefect. Li Shan and Lu Jian were both county assistants: one reported abuses in government and was immediately promoted to vice prefect; the other impeached banner troops for harming the people and was immediately promoted to assistant prefect. Bi Hui and Wang Bo reported misconduct by banner troops and upheld the proper way, receiving a gift of wine. How steadfast these county officials were in upholding what was right! Wang Dixian [?] and Chen Weixian reported military cadets galloping along the public thoroughfare [?], and received wine in recognition of their service. How firmly these prefects enforced the law! As for the man restored to his former office after the local elders went to the palace to plead their case, was this not because Zhu Yungong, as magistrate of Zhucheng, governed …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
政有方歟他如守饒州而斯民咸賴以安
全者此陶安之惠政所以見稱也統處州
而生靈賴以保障者此胡深之撫衆所以
爲可美也章溢之鎮撫處州減賦稅而寬
民力其愛民也可知李文鼎之判簿祁門
陳民害而除弊政其治蹟也何如其所以
表守令盡職之榮而爲天下有司之助者
蓋獨至矣自是而後聞者孰不奮然有所
興起而矧於卓有立之者乎如况鍾之爲
===
蘇州知府簡屬官以去貪庸定徵糧以備
緩急置綱運簿以稽侵盜置舘夫簿以防
需索此其表表者乎劉實之爲南雄知府
請寬貸以救歲旱免雜差以重信義節省商稅
以贍學宮節減供應以抑權貴此其赫赫
者乎乃若通漕省億萬之費鎮靜華誇詐
之俗非林億之再授蘇鎮而何蒼頭供應
門之役異政集去思之碑非楊繼宗之蒞
知嘉興而何又如胡儼之
punctuated: 政有方歟？他如守饒州而斯民咸賴以安全者，此陶安之惠政所以見稱也；統處州而生靈賴以保障者，此胡深之撫衆所以爲可美也。章溢之鎮撫處州，減賦稅而寬民力，其愛民也可知；李文鼎之判簿祁門，陳民害而除弊政，其治蹟也何如？其所以表守令盡職之榮，而爲天下有司之助者，蓋獨至矣。自是而後，聞者孰不奮然有所興起，而矧於卓有立之者乎？如况鍾之爲蘇州知府，簡屬官以去貪庸，定徵糧以備緩急，置綱運簿以稽侵盜，置舘夫簿以防需索，此其表表者乎？劉實之爲南雄知府，請寬貸以救歲旱，免雜差以重信義，節省商稅以贍學宮，節減供應以抑權貴，此其赫赫者乎？乃若通漕省億萬之費，鎮靜華誇詐之俗，非林億之再授蘇鎮而何？蒼頭供應門之役，異政集去思之碑，非楊繼宗之蒞知嘉興而何？又如胡儼之
translation_en:
…governed effectively? Among other examples, when Tao An governed Raozhou, all its people depended on him for their safety: this is why his benevolent administration was praised. When Hu Shen commanded Chuzhou, its people relied on him for protection: this is why his care for the populace deserves admiration. In pacifying and administering Chuzhou, Zhang Yi reduced taxes and eased the burdens on the people’s resources; his love for the people is plain. Li Wending, serving as assistant prefect or registrar [?] in Qimen, reported practices harmful to the people and abolished administrative abuses. How noteworthy were his achievements in government! The means employed to honor prefects and magistrates for fulfilling their duties, and thereby to encourage officials throughout the realm, were surely exceptional. Thereafter, who could hear of these things without being stirred to action—especially those who had already distinguished themselves?

When Kuang Zhong served as prefect of Suzhou, he screened subordinate officials to remove the corrupt and incompetent, established grain-collection arrangements to meet ordinary and urgent needs, created registers of transport consignments to investigate embezzlement, and created registers of relay-hostel attendants to prevent extortion. Were these not outstanding achievements? When Liu Shi served as prefect of Nanxiong, he requested leniency in repayment to relieve distress during a year of drought, waived miscellaneous service obligations to uphold good faith and righteousness, economized on commercial-tax revenues to support the prefectural school [?], and reduced provisioning demands to restrain the powerful. Were these not illustrious achievements?

As for opening grain-transport routes and saving countless sums in expenditure, and calming customs of ostentation and deceit [?], was this not what Lin Yi accomplished upon his reappointment to Suzhou and Zhenjiang [?]? Having household servants perform duties at the gate [?], and having his exceptional administration recorded on a stele commemorating the people’s longing after his departure—was this not Yang Jizong’s achievement as prefect of Jiaxing? Further, there was Hu Yan’s…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
奏免積逋王恕之屢辨疑獄岳正之脩復古
禮而桐城莆揚之人至于今仰之有可徵
也張寧之先教後刑鄧廷瓚之威服夷獠
許逵之練武却賊而汀番樂陵之人至于
今思之有可考也是皆爲郡而卓有異蹟
爲邑而綽有令聞比與陳希文輩特伯仲
之間蓋當時未嘗顯錄是以知之者鮮非
泯泯無聞也意者治化之所沾被士有君
子之行禮法之所漸磨屋多可封之俗清
===
共以圖報稱者比比而然也每人而顯錄
之其將能勝乎故夫爲守若令誠能以前
數者之賢爲法而以今之所當爲者自勉
尚何政之不舉民之難安而於
皇上圖治之心有不可仰
副於萬一哉所以致之當有道矣夫亦使之
以器乎人之才有能不能老成練達者處
之以繁劇而得展其謀悃愊無華者處之
以簡僻而不苦其難隨其才之所施而民
punctuated:
奏免積逋，王恕之屢辨疑獄，岳正之脩復古禮，而桐城、莆揚之人至于今仰之，有可徵也。張寧之先教後刑，鄧廷瓚之威服夷獠，許逵之練武却賊，而汀、番、樂陵之人至于今思之，有可考也。是皆爲郡而卓有異蹟，爲邑而綽有令聞，比與陳希文輩，特伯仲之間。蓋當時未嘗顯錄，是以知之者鮮，非泯泯無聞也。意者，治化之所沾被，士有君子之行；禮法之所漸磨，屋多可封之俗。清共以圖報稱者，比比而然也。每人而顯錄之，其將能勝乎？

故夫爲守若令，誠能以前數者之賢爲法，而以今之所當爲者自勉，尚何政之不舉、民之難安，而於皇上圖治之心，有不可仰副於萬一哉？所以致之，當有道矣。夫亦使之以器乎？人之才有能不能，老成練達者處之以繁劇，而得展其謀；悃愊無華者處之以簡僻，而不苦其難。隨其才之所施，而民
translation_en:
…petitioned for the remission of accumulated arrears; Wang Shu repeatedly resolved doubtful legal cases; and Yue Zheng restored ancient rites. That the people of Tongcheng, Pu, and Yang [?] look up to them even today can be substantiated. Zhang Ning put instruction before punishment; Deng Tingzan brought the Yi and Liao peoples into submission through his authority; and Xu Kui trained troops and repelled bandits. That the people of Ting, Fan [?], and Leling remember them even today can be verified. All these men achieved outstanding results as prefects or won ample good repute as county magistrates. Compared with Chen Xiwen and his peers, they differed only as elder and younger brothers. Presumably their deeds were not prominently recorded at the time, so few people know of them; it was not that they passed their lives in obscurity without distinction. Perhaps, wherever the influence of good government reached, scholars conducted themselves as gentlemen; wherever ritual and law gradually shaped the people, households commonly possessed customs worthy of enfeoffment. Those who sought, through integrity and reverence [?], to repay imperial favor and meet expectations were everywhere. Could one ever finish recording every such person prominently?

Thus, if prefects and county magistrates can sincerely take the worthiness of the foregoing men as their model, and spur themselves on to do what present circumstances require, what governmental undertaking could remain unaccomplished, and how could the people prove difficult to settle in peace? How could they fail to fulfill even one ten-thousandth of His Majesty’s desire for good government? There must be a way to bring this about. Might it lie in employing men according to their capacities? People’s abilities have their strengths and limitations. Assign mature, experienced men to demanding posts, where they can put their plans into practice; assign sincere, unadorned men to simple duties in remote places, where they will not be burdened by difficulties beyond them. Let each exercise his abilities where they are suited, and the people…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
自有得所之望矣無已徵之以事乎才之
用有效不效尚賢以崇德如赤子之慕慈
母也簡不肖以紏惡如鷹鸇之逐鳥雀也
分其類之不爽民將免播惡之患矣無已
責之有要乎有志者或數易則習者之功
不能以及其成要必循六年九年之例俟
有顯效
旌異賞勞增秩加官不少靳焉則民無迎送
之費而且得服馴之利矣升轉者或不重
===
則勸士之輕不足以酬其志果於出政保
民之間著有成績京丞卿佐臬省撫督必
拔擢焉則人有遠大之期而自堅向往之
念矣不但已也於此又有要焉持大公以
立其本定紀綱以飭其法二者並行而守
令之賢可必至矣所謂持大公以定紀綱
者豈他求哉付之監司以核名實責之
制使以明舉措總之臺省以計殿最歸之政
本以行黜陟焉已矣執此之令堅如金石
punctuated:
自有得所之望矣。無已，徵之以事乎？才之用，有效不效。尚賢以崇德，如赤子之慕慈母也；簡不肖以紏惡，如鷹鸇之逐鳥雀也。分其類之不爽，民將免播惡之患矣。無已，責之有要乎？有志者或數易，則習者之功不能以及其成。要必循六年九年之例，俟有顯效，旌異賞勞，增秩加官，不少靳焉，則民無迎送之費，而且得服馴之利矣。升轉者或不重，則勸士之輕不足以酬其志。果於出政保民之間著有成績，京丞卿佐、臬省撫督，必拔擢焉，則人有遠大之期，而自堅向往之念矣。
不但已也，於此又有要焉。持大公以立其本，定紀綱以飭其法，二者並行，而守令之賢可必至矣。所謂持大公以定紀綱者，豈他求哉？付之監司以核名實，責之制使以明舉措，總之臺省以計殿最，歸之政本以行黜陟焉已矣。執此之令，堅如金石，
translation_en:
…the people will naturally have hope of finding their proper place. Beyond this, should officials not be tested through their deeds? The employment of talent may be effective or ineffective. Esteem the worthy to exalt virtue, as an infant longs for its loving mother; distinguish the unworthy to correct wrongdoing, as hawks and falcons pursue smaller birds. If these categories are distinguished without error, the people will escape the harm of spreading wickedness. Beyond this, should there not be essential principles for holding officials accountable? If officials with resolve are frequently replaced, the efforts of those who have gained experience cannot reach fruition. It is essential to follow the precedents of six-year and nine-year terms, await manifest results, honor exceptional merit and reward service, and raise rank and confer office without the slightest stint. Then the people will incur no expense in welcoming and seeing off officials, and will also enjoy the benefits of becoming accustomed to their governance. If promotions and transfers carry insufficient weight, such slight encouragement to men of service will not adequately reward their aspirations. Those who truly achieve conspicuous results in administering government and protecting the people must be promoted to posts as capital assistants and ministers’ deputies, provincial surveillance and administrative officials, grand coordinators, and supreme commanders [?]. Officials will then have prospects of far-reaching advancement and will naturally strengthen their determination to pursue it.
Nor is this all: there is a further essential point. Uphold complete impartiality to establish the foundation, and settle the governing principles to put the regulations in order. If both are pursued together, worthy prefects and magistrates can assuredly be obtained. What is meant by upholding complete impartiality and settling the governing principles—must it be sought elsewhere? Entrust verification of reputation against actual performance to the surveillance authorities; charge the imperial commissioners with making clear distinctions in recommending and rejecting officials; coordinate the assessment of inferior and superior performance through the central censorial and administrative authorities; and refer dismissals and promotions to the central governing authority. That is all. Hold firmly to this ordinance, as steadfastly as metal and stone…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
行此之令信如四時弗苟且於目前務求
臻乎實效則政不勞而臥赤子於衽席矣
田里愁歎將安生哉然非愚一人之言乃
國家已試之政顧操柄者力行何如耳不識
執事以爲然否
punctuated: 行此之令，信如四時，弗苟且於目前，務求臻乎實效，則政不勞而臥赤子於衽席矣。田里愁歎將安生哉？然非愚一人之言，乃國家已試之政，顧操柄者力行何如耳。不識執事以爲然否？
translation_en: …If these directives are carried out as reliably as the four seasons, without seeking expedient results for the moment, but striving to achieve substantive effects, then government will proceed without toil and the common people will rest securely upon their bedding. How could sorrow and lamentation then arise in the villages? Yet these are not merely the words of this one foolish man: they are policies already tested by the state. It depends only on how vigorously those who wield authority put them into practice. I do not know whether you, sir, consider this view correct.

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄後序
歲丙午天下當大比取士河
南省臣遵例舉故事一時慎
選僚屬充内外簾役罔不惟
公惟寅期於必得良士以爲
聖天子獻業既竣〔用賓〕濫與考文
之列法亦得申告乃颺言曰
===
爾多士進矣進以文也三試
之而學以明經行以迪德識
以用世雖未見底裏而士之
呈身以請獻者斯亦知其大
端成周之所謂賢者能者非
耶且爾知夫是舉乎固將歌
鹿鳴而講賓興之禮籍其姓
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄後序

歲丙午，天下當大比取士。河南省臣遵例舉故事，一時慎選僚屬充内外簾役，罔不惟公惟寅，期於必得良士，以爲聖天子獻。業既竣，〔用賓〕濫與考文之列，法亦得申告，乃颺言曰：「爾多士進矣，進以文也。三試之，而學以明經，行以迪德，識以用世。雖未見底裏，而士之呈身以請獻者，斯亦知其大端。成周之所謂賢者能者，非耶？且爾知夫是舉乎？固將歌《鹿鳴》而講賓興之禮，籍其姓
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

In the bingwu year [1546], the realm was due to hold the triennial examination to select scholars. The provincial officials of Henan followed established regulations and precedents. They carefully selected subordinate officials to serve within and outside the examination curtains. All acted with impartiality and reverence, determined to obtain worthy scholars to present to the sagely Son of Heaven. When the work was complete, I, 〔Yongbin〕, having unworthily held a place among those examining the compositions, was also entitled under the regulations to deliver an admonition. I therefore proclaimed:

“You scholars have advanced—advanced through your writing. You have been examined in three sessions: in learning, to elucidate the Classics; in conduct, to follow the path of virtue; and in discernment, to serve the world. Although we have not yet seen into your innermost depths, through your presentation of yourselves as scholars seeking to offer your services, we can already discern your principal qualities. Are you not those whom the Zhou called the worthy and the capable? Moreover, do you understand the meaning of this selection? We shall indeed sing ‘The Deer Call’ and perform the ceremony of honoring the selected scholars as guests, recording their surnames…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
名文字偕計吏以貢於
上登于
天府曁會於南宮又將乘傳導之
使行夫士而未進誠草茅之
流也今一旦與諸大夫相酬
酢是以賢能之可尊而尊其
人也以草茅之言而獲登之
===
天府是以賢能之可敬而敬其書
也行得與公使竝驅而錧轂
之是以賢能之可重而重其
往也若是則爾多士亦可謂
榮而遇且幸矣盍自省焉吾
之經術果能明以懋學乎吾
之德行果能飭以治躬乎吾
punctuated: 名文字，偕計吏以貢於上，登于天府。曁會於南宮，又將乘傳導之使行。夫士而未進，誠草茅之流也；今一旦與諸大夫相酬酢，是以賢能之可尊而尊其人也。以草茅之言而獲登之天府，是以賢能之可敬而敬其書也。行得與公使竝驅而錧轂之，是以賢能之可重而重其往也。若是，則爾多士亦可謂榮而遇且幸矣！盍自省焉：吾之經術，果能明以懋學乎？吾之德行，果能飭以治躬乎？吾
translation_en: …names and written compositions, to be presented to His Majesty together with the officials bearing accounts and entered into the imperial repositories. When the time comes to assemble at the Ministry of Rites for the Metropolitan Examination, they will also be conveyed on their way by relay carriage. Before a scholar has advanced, he is indeed one of those living in rustic obscurity. Now, suddenly, he exchanges courtesies with the high officials: because worth and ability deserve honor, his person is honored. That words from rustic obscurity may be entered into the imperial repositories means that, because worth and ability deserve respect, his writings are respected. That on his journey he may travel alongside official envoys and be furnished with a carriage [?] means that, because worth and ability deserve esteem, his departure is treated with esteem. Thus you scholars may indeed be called honored, favored, and fortunate! Why not examine yourselves: Have I truly attained clarity in my understanding of the Classics, so as to advance my learning? Have I truly disciplined my moral conduct, so as to cultivate myself? Have I …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
之才識果能備以用世乎有
一弗當是爲不忝恥莫大焉
主司者復諄諄然求之於言
語文字之間唯恐不力是其
責抑又浮於士矣吁可懼乎
哉昔宋朱熹議程氏子貢舉
之說有曰欲求程子這樣事
===
須得程子這樣人然則苟得
顥頤其人以當此時賢能之
求則吾主司之責或亦不孤
不亦快然有所慊於心乎顥
頤二子生於河洛爾多士之
鄉人其在當時卓然自立如
青城講書根極理要龍門傳
punctuated: 之才識果能備以用世乎？有一弗當，是爲不忝，恥莫大焉。主司者復諄諄然求之於言語文字之間，唯恐不力，是其責抑又浮於士矣。吁，可懼乎哉！昔宋朱熹議程氏子貢舉之說，有曰：「欲求程子這樣事，須得程子這樣人。」然則苟得顥、頤其人，以當此時賢能之求，則吾主司之責或亦不孤，不亦快然有所慊於心乎？顥、頤二子生於河洛，爾多士之鄉人。其在當時，卓然自立，如青城講書，根極理要，龍門傳
translation_en:
…are my abilities and discernment truly sufficient for service in the world? If even one of these requirements is unmet, this is to be “without disgrace” [?]; no shame could be greater. Those presiding over the examination must, in turn, earnestly seek these qualities in the candidates’ words and writings, fearing only that their efforts may be insufficient. Their responsibility is thus even greater than that of the candidates. Ah, how daunting!

Formerly, Zhu Xi of the Song, discussing Master Cheng’s proposals for recommending and selecting candidates, said: “To achieve the sort of thing Master Cheng envisaged, one must have someone like Master Cheng.” If, then, we could obtain men like Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi to answer the present demand for the worthy and capable, perhaps we who preside over the examination would not fail our charge. Would that not bring us joy and satisfaction in our hearts? The two masters, Hao and Yi, were born in the region of the Yellow and Luo Rivers and were fellow countrymen of you candidates. In their day they stood preeminent and independent: lecturing on the Documents at Qingcheng, they probed principles to their roots and essentials; at Longmen, transmitting …

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
易研徹精微其經術有如此
者玉色金聲氣象和粹規圓
矩方操履端嚴其德行有如
此者裨賛宋朝得御史體衍
說義理真侍講官其才識有
如此者續鄒魯道學之傳負
康濟民物之略誠命世之儒
===
而爲善治之軌也固有志嚮
往而尚友者亦弗能外焉爾
多士之明經而迪德識達而
用世果能尚友其人而有獲
於嚮往之餘否乎如果嚮往
而尚友之以有獲焉則出而
賛翊
punctuated: 易，研徹精微，其經術有如此者；玉色金聲，氣象和粹，規圓矩方，操履端嚴，其德行有如此者；裨賛宋朝，得御史體，衍說義理，真侍講官，其才識有如此者。續鄒魯道學之傳，負康濟民物之略，誠命世之儒，而爲善治之軌也。固有志嚮往而尚友者，亦弗能外焉。爾多士之明經而迪德、識達而用世，果能尚友其人而有獲於嚮往之餘否乎？如果嚮往而尚友之，以有獲焉，則出而賛翊
translation_en:
…the Changes, probing its most subtle meanings: such was their classical learning. With countenances like jade and voices like gold, their bearing harmonious and pure, their conduct conforming to compass and square, upright and dignified: such was their moral character. Assisting the Song court, they exemplified the proper bearing of a censor; expounding moral principles, they were true Expositors-in-waiting: such were their abilities and understanding. They continued the transmission of the Learning of the Way from Zou and Lu and possessed plans for bringing peace and relief to the people and all living things. Truly, they were Confucian scholars born to serve their age and models for good government. Those resolved to emulate the ancients and befriend them in spirit surely cannot look beyond these men.
You, the many scholars, elucidate the classics and advance in virtue, seeking breadth of understanding and service in the world. Can you indeed befriend these men in spirit and gain something through your aspiration to emulate them? If you truly aspire to emulate them and befriend them in spirit, and thereby gain something, then you will enter public service and assist…

title: 嘉靖二十五年河南鄉試錄
text:
治化康理民物固自有不負
朝廷側席之求而吾屬以人事
君之責亦庶乎其少塞哉夫不知
其人者愚也知而鄉往之弗
勤者怠也溺於習俗而莫克
尚友者是自畀也士而愚且
怠以畀乃猶嘵嘵焉眞贗胥
===
淆闇然欲售於世殆凡民之
不若匪直恥也盭將至矣於
乎不恥不若人何若人有爾
多士其勗之哉
浙江衢州府常山縣儒學教
諭鄭〔用賓〕謹序
punctuated:
治化，康理民物，固自有不負朝廷側席之求，而吾屬以人事君之責，亦庶乎其少塞哉！夫不知其人者，愚也；知而鄉往之弗勤者，怠也；溺於習俗而莫克尚友者，是自畀也。士而愚且怠以畀，乃猶嘵嘵焉，眞贗胥淆，闇然欲售於世，殆凡民之不若，匪直恥也，盭將至矣。於乎！不恥不若人，何若人有？爾多士其勗之哉！
浙江衢州府常山縣儒學教諭鄭〔用賓〕謹序。
translation_en:
…the transforming work of government and bring peace and order to the people and all things, you will assuredly not disappoint the court’s eager search for worthy men; and we, too, may thereby fulfill at least some small part of our responsibility to serve the ruler by providing him with men of worth. Not to know such men is ignorance; to know them but fail to strive diligently toward their example is indolence; to become immersed in prevailing customs and prove unable to befriend the worthy of antiquity is to abandon oneself [?]. A scholar who is ignorant, indolent, and thus abandons himself [?], yet still clamors noisily, mingling the genuine with the spurious and blindly seeking acceptance in the world, is probably beneath even the common people. This is more than a disgrace: perversity will follow. Alas! If one is not ashamed of falling short of others, how can one ever equal them? You assembled scholars, strive earnestly!
Respectfully prefaced by Zheng Yongbin, Instructor of the Confucian School of Changshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang.
